body.purpose: Message and composer text; native platform family.

components.name: Message field
components.description: Flexible raised composer field. HTML snippets are panel translations, not additional native implementation.

components.name: Emoticon search
components.description: Compact search field used above the six-column emoticon collection.
components.html: <input class="ds-search" aria-label="Search Steam emoticons" placeholder="Search emoticons"/>

components.name: Incoming message
components.description: A raised bubble with an author-side lower corner and subordinate timestamp.

components.name: Outgoing message
components.description: The blue counterpart aligned to the author side.

narrative.overview: This is a record of the incumbent interface, not a new visual identity. The app is a dark, mobile-first tool for conversation: restrained chrome, a flexible message area, and compact controls anchored below it. The media additions inherit that system.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal tonal layers with blue actions and pale content.
Native platform body typography and familiar symbol icons.
Small control corners, square avatars, and directional message bubbles.
Visible loading, disabled, failure, empty, and recovery states.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Reuse `SteamColors` for shared roles. The light accent marks links and selected controls; the deeper accent fills Send and outgoing bubbles. Muted text carries secondary information, not the main message.

dos: Do preserve the existing token palette and compact mobile control geometry.
Do preserve native accessibility labels, touch targets, and safe-area spacing.
Do keep readable text when an image or emoticon cannot load.
donts: Don't turn a local composer feature into a new visual identity.
Don't replace symbol controls with decorative emoji or text glyphs.
Don't treat synthetic web-preview content as product or native-device evidence.
